notes: The before PDF measurement used pdf-lib's eager native RGBA decode and save-time embedding after sequential page handoff.

The PDF-only notebook-worker mode produces opaque RGB PNGs with the platform deflate stream while ordinary PNG exports retain their byte-identical RGBA path. The one-shot PDF worker embeds the RGB Flate stream directly and retains pdf-lib's compatible fallback for other PNG color types.
Font files are gzip-compressed at build time, decoded only on first PDF use, and subset in exported PDFs.
The after pipeline creates and encodes a distinct handwriting-like native RGBA page with at least 102,178 inked pixels for every PDF page and polls memory throughout encode and embed.

The production-bundle first-use harness measures lazy client import, inline-worker Blob construction, and a 256 KiB first-page transport through a protocol stub. Browser worker readiness remains part of real-device validation.
The mobile figures are the mobile budget contract measured on the recorded local Apple M4 Pro environment, not a physical mobile-device profile; real-device validation remains outstanding.
